name: simstudio-app
description: Sim Studio is an AI-powered development environment for building and testing agents. This is the main application server providing the web interface, API, and collaboration features. Features: AI agent development, real-time collaboration, semantic search with vector embeddings, and integrated development tools. Requires: simstudio-db (PostgreSQL with pgvector), simstudio-realtime (WebSocket), and simstudio-valkey (session storage).

ports.name: Port: Web UI
ports.description: Sim Studio web interface and API port

variables.name: --- Database ---
variables.description: PostgreSQL connection settings. Must match simstudio-db configuration.

variables.name: DATABASE_URL
variables.description: PostgreSQL connection URL (format: postgresql://user:password@host:port/database). Must match simstudio-db.

variables.name: --- Authentication & Security ---
variables.description: Authentication and security configuration.

variables.name: BETTER_AUTH_SECRET
variables.description: Authentication secret key (shared with simstudio-realtime). Must be 32+ characters. Generate: openssl rand -base64 32

variables.name: BETTER_AUTH_URL
variables.description: Base URL for authentication (same as NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL)

variables.name: INTERNAL_API_SECRET
variables.description: Secret for internal service-to-service communication (shared with simstudio-realtime). Generate: openssl rand -base64 32

variables.name: ENCRYPTION_KEY
variables.description: Data encryption key for sensitive information. Generate: openssl rand -base64 32

variables.name: API_ENCRYPTION_KEY
variables.description: API-specific encryption key. Generate: openssl rand -base64 32

variables.name: --- Application URLs ---
variables.description: Public URLs and domain configuration.

variables.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL
variables.description: Public application URL (e.g., http://your-server-ip:3000 or https://simstudio.example.com). Used by browser clients.

variables.name: TRUSTED_ORIGINS
variables.description: Comma-separated list of additional trusted origins for authentication (e.g., apex + www, aliases, reverse-proxy IPs). Leave empty to use only NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL.

variables.name: --- Realtime & WebSocket ---
variables.description: Real-time communication settings.

variables.name: SOCKET_SERVER_URL
variables.description: Internal URL for WebSocket server (container-to-container)

variables.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_SOCKET_URL
variables.description: Public WebSocket URL for browser clients. Leave empty to use page origin (requires reverse proxy to route /socket.io). Set explicitly if realtime is on different host:port (e.g., wss://socket.example.com).

variables.name: --- Valkey Session Storage ---
variables.description: Redis/Valkey connection for session persistence.

variables.name: REDIS_URL
variables.description: Valkey connection URL (format: redis://host:port/db)

variables.name: --- External APIs ---
variables.description: Third-party API integrations.

variables.name: COPILOT_API_KEY
variables.description: GitHub Copilot API key for AI features

variables.name: SIM_AGENT_API_URL
variables.description: URL for Sim Agent API (e.g., http://agent-service:port)

variables.name: OLLAMA_URL
variables.description: Ollama API endpoint for local LLM inference (optional)

variables.name: --- Performance ---
variables.description: Performance tuning and resource limits.

variables.name: ADMISSION_GATE_MAX_INFLIGHT
variables.description: Maximum number of concurrent inflight requests to the admission gate

variables.name: --- System ---
variables.description: Node.js and timezone configuration.

variables.name: NODE_ENV
variables.description: Node.js environment (production/development)

variables.name: Variable: TZ
variables.description: Timezone. See: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_tz_database_time_zones#List

variables.name: --- Advanced ---
variables.description: Advanced settings and debugging options.

variables.name: LOG_LEVEL
variables.description: Log verbosity: error, warn, info, debug
